listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Brawl — META-K (BannedPenta01)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream menus/character-select about25FPS; native fat-module matches wedge/crash, slim hybrid matches reported stable. README explicitly calls it a research artifact, not a playable Brawl port. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Wii Brawl ISO/RVZ; exact revision unknown.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream documents Windows source setup with VS2022 Build Tools,CMake,Ninja,Python3.8+ and recursive DolRecomp/ModernGekko submodules. Use run_gui.bat with an owned SSBB ISO/RVZ for local extraction, static recompilation and runtime launch. The README clone example uses a placeholder owner; use this exact upstream repository identity. The fat-module/nativeREL research route can crash; the alternate stable slim-module route uses JIT and is not all-static native. No package or runtime was obtained or executed here.
